title: Fast Karhunen-Loève Expansions via FFT-Accelerated Toeplitz Operators
summary: Gaussian random fields are a versatile tool used in the fields of stochastic PDEs, uncertainty quantification, and geostatistical simulation. One way to obtain them is to use a truncated Karhunen-Loève expansion (KLE). Computing the expansion requires the leading eigenpairs of an $N \times N$ covariance matrix, where $N$ is the total number of grid cells. These are usually computed with a Krylov eigensolver, which relies on the covariance operator only within matrix-vector products.
